## 本周报道 | This week’s report

**中文。** 报道介绍法意边境附近 Riparo Mochi 新发掘的炉址、石器与海贝测年。所报海贝年代约为 30,000—30,800 年前，为该地 Noaillian 技术传统的年代重评提供材料；石器使用痕迹也涉及工具功能的重新解释。

**English.** Reporting describes a newly excavated hearth, lithics and marine-shell dating at Riparo Mochi near the French–Italian border. The reported shell ages of about 30,000–30,800 years inform reassessment of the local Noaillian chronology, while use-wear contributes to interpretations of tool function.

## 日期与既往工作 | Dates and earlier work

**中文。** Phys.org 报道日期为 2026-11-10；所引论文 DOI 为 10.1016/j.jasrep.2026.106131，首次在线发表日未独立核实。遗址曾有较早发掘。

**English.** Phys.org reported the work on 2026-11-10. The cited paper is DOI 10.1016/j.jasrep.2026.106131; its first online publication day was not independently verified. The site had earlier excavations.

## 解释边界 | Limits of interpretation

**中文。** 材料年代、技术传统传播与人群迁徙是不同层次的推论；本期不将其写成已由遗传证据证明的族群迁移，也不据新闻日期判定首次学术发表资格。原论文全文访问受限。

**English.** Dating material, tracing a technological tradition and inferring population movement are different steps. This digest does not treat migration as genetically demonstrated or use the news date to establish first scholarly publication. Full-paper access was restricted.
